# 2. Map FOXP3 to Ensembl ID

ensembl_entry = q['hits'][0].get('ensembl')
ensembl_id = ensembl_entry[0]['gene'] if isinstance(ensembl_entry, list) else ensembl_entry['gene']

# 3. Extract FOXP3 expression
mask = gene_expr.index.to_series().str.startswith(ensembl_id)
fo_expr = gene_expr[mask].iloc[0]
fo_expr.index = fo_expr.index.str[:12]  # convert sample to patient barcode
patient_fo = fo_expr.groupby(level=0).median()
patient_fo.name = 'FOXP3_expression'
patient_df = patient_fo.reset_index().rename(columns={'index': 'bcr_patient_barcode'})

# 4. Prepare clinical subset
col_event = 'new_tumor_event_after_initial_treatment'
clinical_sub = clinical[['bcr_patient_barcode', col_event, 'age_at_diagnosis', 'gender']].dropna()
clinical_sub['age_at_diagnosis'] = pd.to_numeric(clinical_sub['age_at_diagnosis'], errors='coerce')
clinical_sub = clinical_sub.dropna(subset=['age_at_diagnosis'])

# 5. Merge and recode

df = df[df[col_event].isin(['YES', 'NO'])]
df['event_binary'] = df[col_event].map({'YES': 1, 'NO': 0})

df['FOXP3_group'] = np.where(df['FOXP3_expression'] >= df['FOXP3_expression'].median(), 'High', 'Low')

odds_ratio, p_fisher = fisher_exact(cont_table.values)

model = smf.logit('event_binary ~ C(FOXP3_group) + age_at_diagnosis + C(gender)', df).fit(disp=False)
print("Logistic regression summary:")
print(model.summary())
